text.p: Following is factfile on Miguel Indurain, who announced his retirment on Thursday after his contract with Spanish team Banesto ran out on Tuesday:

Tour de France wins: 1991, 1992, 1993, 1994, 1995. First rider ever to win five consecutive Tours and equal overall record of five wins set by Jacques Anquetil, Eddy Merckx and Bernard Hinault. Failed in 1996, finishing 11th, more than 14 minutes behind winner Bjarne Riis of Denmark.

Second in Vuelta de Espana in 1991 and then chose to miss the race until this year when he came under pressure to take part. Pulled out 30 km from end of 13th stage after struggling to keep in touch on a tough mountain section. Had been lying in third place.
